versions.label: Original
versions.referenceNote: MuseScore's own playback goes through measures 47-50 three times and then on to 51. The brackets on the sheet (1, 2, 3 and 4) say a fourth time through 47-49 before 51, so the app plays those 3 measures once more. Everything else is the same note for note.

keySources.quote: In the same key as the original: D

tempoSources.quote: Same as the original tempo: 135 BPM (a comment there says it is the album version)

tempoNote: Your file has no tempo. Claude set 139, the record's tempo as Hooktheory gives it (audiokeychain: 140). MuseScore would play it at 120.

chordSources.note: Shown only as a link; Claude read I V/vi vi IV in D major as D, F♯, B minor, G.

pedalNote: The score has no pedal marks. Claude added a change on every beat: a pedal held through the whole measure would make the right hand's A, G and F♯ (neighbouring keys) ring together, while a change on each beat keeps each melody note with the bass only. It sounds fine without pedal too, so it starts switched off.
chordsNote: Both pages have F♯ major; this arrangement plays F♯ minor there (A instead of A♯). Claude checked those measures note by note.
fingeringNote: No page with finger numbers for this song was found (searched: Pianote, Hooktheory, Musicnotes, chord sites).

fingeringClaude.note: The right-hand riff is Claude's fingering, not from a page: the thumb stays on D (or C♯) and fingers 5, 4, 3 play A, G, F♯, the same in every measure of the riff; the measures in octaves keep the app's suggestion (1 and 5 on each octave)
